translations.web: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
translations.bsb: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early, but the other basket contained very poor figs, so bad they could not be eaten.
translations.kjv: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
